description: This file implements an asynchronous checkpoint executor using threading, providing functions and classes to manage saving model checkpoints asynchronously within PyTorch's distributed framework.

classes.name: _ThreadBasedAsyncCheckpointExecutor
classes.description: A threading-based asynchronous checkpoint executor for performing checkpoint save operations in a separate thread.
